explanation.headline: FDA's records trace this shortage to a plant on our own labels

sentences.text: Corvale East holds 553 units of levofloxacin at 32.2 a day, providing 17 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 602 units at 30.9 a day, providing 19 days on hand.
One registered plant on our labels, ASCLEMED USA INC. DBA ENOVACHEM (FEI 3001452204), received an OAI classification on 2018-09-27 per FDA inspection 1067059.
FDA issued a Warning Letter to the same plant on 2019-06-11.
The other registered plant, Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited -FTO III (FEI 3002949099), has only VAI inspections, most recently on 2023-10-27.
Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is not on FDA's shortage list today and is the best option by rule.

Q-4fe147.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%levofloxacin%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%levofloxacin%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-3bd1b4.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('9b59428a-a23a-b2d9-982f-98f8a1ed381f', '2e32a8aa-047b-46c6-b67b-d88a9a0a810b') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-e0785c.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%levofloxacin%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-2f4e6a.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%levofloxacin%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-6b2e9d.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%levofloxacin%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-db2bf5.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3001452204', '3002949099', '3008307735', '3004582966') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-2e2da2.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3001452204', '3002949099', '3008307735', '3004582966') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-ddf4e0.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3001452204', '3002949099') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('asclemed dba enovachem', 'dr reddy s fto iii', 'dr reddy s')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-958f55.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('asclemed dba enovachem', 'dr reddy s fto iii', 'dr reddy s', 'asclemed') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%levofloxacin%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-a01d46.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('1067059') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-efcf92.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('55111028001', '76420081705')

Q-d7a971.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%levofloxacin%'
